verdict.rationale: Formant documents a programmable command path to real robots. Commands trigger predefined robot actions such as running a script or returning home, and custom commands can be created via the Admin API. The on-device Agent SDK receives and responds to commands and supports teleoperation, and the toolkit lets developers build apps on Formant's APIs and RealtimeSDK. However, the evidence shows commands being sent mainly from UI buttons, teleop, or events, and nothing documents agent authentication with scoped credentials or an AI agent driving the robot end-to-end through the API. Missing for 10: documented scoped API credentials or service accounts for agents, explicit cloud API/SDK method to dispatch commands programmatically, a published OpenAPI spec (probe 404), an AI-agent end-to-end example, and independent hands-on corroboration.
